questions.question: How has the internet affected the English language?
options: It has accelerated language change dramatically
It has frozen the language in place
It has eliminated all new words
questions.explanation: Digital communication creates new words, new meanings and new conventions at unprecedented speed.

questions.question: Which is an example of an existing word gaining a new meaning in the digital age?
questions.explanation: Words like viral, cloud and stream gained new digital meanings; selfie and hashtag are new coinages.

questions.question: What is the chapter's answer to whether internet language is "ruining" English?
options: No — it is creative, follows systematic rules and creates new expressive possibilities
Yes — English will disappear within decades
The question is impossible to discuss
questions.explanation: Internet language follows its own systematic rules, demonstrates linguistic creativity and will likely contribute lasting vocabulary.

questions.question: How can punctuation carry meaning in digital communication?
options: Punctuation and capitalization can signal emotion and tone
questions.explanation: In digital writing, a full stop, ALL CAPS or missing punctuation can signal tone and emotion.

questions.question: What does code-switching mean in the context of digital communication?
options: Shifting between informal digital style and formal writing depending on context
questions.explanation: Competent communicators switch between digital informality and formal registers depending on the situation.
